purpose: Draft candidate BHK (Bedroom-Hall-Kitchen) type reference rows for an Indian real-estate/property-listing application. bhk_type has no independent verified provider — this is the one master type this prompt pattern is fully wired for end to end.
scope: Only standard, widely-recognized Indian residential unit-size codes. Do not invent regional or hypothetical variants not in general real-estate use.

fieldFormats.code: Uppercase, no spaces, must exactly match one of the allowed values listed below.
fieldFormats.label: Short human-readable label, e.g. '2 Bedroom Hall Kitchen'.
fieldFormats.evidence: One sentence explaining why this code/label pairing is standard usage — not a citation, and never treated as independent verification on its own.

evidenceRequirements: State in one sentence why this is standard terminology. This is context for a human reviewer, not proof — a code is only marked verified here because it matches the fixed allowed-values list above, checked deterministically in Java, never because the model asserted it.
exampleResponse: [{"code":"2BHK","label":"2 Bedroom Hall Kitchen","evidence":"Standard Indian real-estate shorthand for a 2-bedroom apartment with a hall and kitchen, used across virtually all major listing platforms."}]
